## RE:volution Mod v1.3.6

### Added

- Runtime Location/Mob Spawn loading from dedicated Mongo collections without changing the legacy `custom_mobs` schema.
- One physical entity per Mob Spawn slot, with multiple slots able to reuse one logical mob definition.
- Runtime support for all four combinations of `FIXED_POINT` / `RANDOM_AREA` and `STATIONARY` / `ROAMING`.
- Player-Realm replication of one spawn configuration into Realm 1/2/3, while Realm 0 remains explicit-only.
- Mob-zone addressing by world `locationId` + `mobSlotId`, allowing multiple independent mob groups inside one world location.
- `/custommob location set <locationId> <mobSlotId> <radius>` for zone geometry.
- `/custommob location populate <locationId> <mobSlotId> <mobName> <count>` for automatic ordinary-mob population.
- `/custommob location clear <locationId> <mobSlotId>` to remove a zone population while keeping its geometry.
- `/custommob location remove <locationId> <mobSlotId>` to remove both zone population and geometry.
- Automatic 50/50 fixed/random population: fixed mobs are evenly spread across the disk and all populated mobs use `ROAMING`; odd counts give the extra slot to `FIXED_POINT`.
- `/custommob location here` to show every configured mob zone containing the current position.
- `/custommob location list <locationId>` to list the mob slots configured for one world location.
- Safe surface-Y lookup for random-area spawning.
- Independent `RANDOM_AREA` position selection on every gameplay spawn and post-kill respawn. A roll may naturally resolve to the same or a nearby point as the previous life.
- Per-life initial/fallback positions for random-area mobs, used by roaming boundary recovery only until the next death.
- Roaming boundary steering and emergency return after leaving the Location radius by roughly two blocks.
- Roaming separation steering with a preferred spacing of roughly four blocks so managed mobs spread across more of their zone instead of clustering.
- One-second roaming pause after direct player hits; repeated hits reset the pause.

### Fixed

- Existing enabled legacy mob spawns remain compatible in Realm 0 until a v1.3.6 Mob Spawn slot is configured for that mob.
- Random-area mobs no longer depend on a preconfigured Y value when a valid map surface can be resolved.
- `RANDOM_AREA` no longer reuses one resolved spawn point for every post-kill respawn in the same runtime session.
- Managed mob ticking no longer repeatedly loads and unloads idle Realm dimensions after players leave them.
- Generated and random managed-mob spawn surfaces reject leaves/logs and do not climb more than three blocks above their base Y, preventing common tree-top/high-local-elevation spawns.
- Fixed generated points search a nearby safe point inside the same zone when their preferred position is blocked by unsuitable terrain.
- Poison ticks do not trigger the direct-hit roaming pause.

### Other

- `STATIONARY` remains available for future bosses and special mobs but is not used by the ordinary `location populate` flow.
- Existing low-level `/custommob spawn set|list|remove` commands remain available for manual/special configuration.
- Existing `custom_mobs` documents, rewards and virtual-health behavior remain compatible.
- Contribution rewards, HP rollback, progression and scaling remain outside v1.3.6.

### Download

The release build produces `RE-volution-1.3.6.jar` after runtime acceptance and release promotion.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/compare/v1.3.5...v1.3.6
